checks.title: claim projection shares migration rollback transaction
successful migration retains current and former roots with provenance
new binding cannot claim current/former root or alias, even for same task
retained new-binding root blocks actual legacy create and first bind
retained claim source cannot be deleted independently
actual copy adoption and binding/revision/claim changes roll back and commit together

scope: Actual copy/session registry and schema plus isolated M14 claim projection, migration hook and synchronous adoption callback. Synthetic new-binding root change, no real provider. No full TaskService, unknown/held/corrupt source migration, cross-process projection recovery, final resource/GC integration or product modification.
